💎 Try Mobbin for free and get 20% off for your first year's subscription: https://mobbin.com/uxpeak

📘 Get the UI/UX Playbook → https://www.uxpeak.com/pages/playbook 🎁 Use code PLAYBOOK15 for 15% off

Same product. Same price. Same traffic. One page converts at 2%, the other at 7%. In this video, we break down every single design decision that creates that 3.5x difference — from the hero image and social proof to the subscription cards and the "Add to Cart" button.

If you want to stop guessing and start designing pages that actually sell, this one's for you. 👇

🧠 WHAT YOU'LL LEARN 

✅ The psychology behind high-converting product pages 
✅ How to use social proof that feels real (not fake) 
✅ Why dropdowns kill conversions — and what to use instead 
✅ How to increase Average Order Value without being pushy 
✅ The micro-interactions that remove buyer hesitation 
✅ Button copy and trust signals that actually work in 2026

‼️ Important note: Use these tips ethically. Never ever share false, exaggerated, or fabricated information about reviews, ratings, sales demand, product features, customer results, or availability! Everything you show should be accurate, up to date, and authentic. The goal is not to pressure, trick, or mislead users. The goal is to communicate real value more clearly and help users make confident decisions. 

Good UX should support both the business and the user. Conversion matters, but trust matters more. ❤
